title: Fail authenticated DAO origination closed on missing or corrupt TX recovery
description: P1 correctness/protocol: DaoManager._restore_tx_state() suppresses DaoPersistenceError whenever require_crash_safety=False, even when origin_identity is configured. Public build_dao() subsequently accepts the same crash-safe/fail-closed backend and originates from sequence 1, reusing a previously acknowledged Origin Sequence after corruption. TwoSlotFilePersistence also treats deletion of both TX slots as a fresh store with no explicit bootstrap/rollback anchor, so a restart can reset authenticated origination silently. Make public authenticated origination retain a terminal recovery failure independent of the legacy test flag, distinguish explicitly authorized first bootstrap from deletion/rollback, and validate restored sequence/bytes before permitting transmit.
